threshold_calibration.freeze_statement: P5 uses a sharp symmetric wall-contact band: contact_threshold_m = 0.02, penetration_tolerance_m = 0.02. This intentionally favors precision over recall on Replica room_0. The only real wall-contact QA positive under this threshold is obj_6 lamp against wall_33_yplus. Looser thresholds admit more objects but also structural contamination (pillars/window), so they are not used for the canonical Phase 5 fixture.

wall_gap_distribution_observed.candidate_set: entity x wall pairs with footprint over the wall polygon (in_plane_gap == 0), centroid on the interior side, and sd_min < 0.30
wall_gap_distribution_observed.systematic_fit_bias: none (gaps roughly symmetric around 0, unlike the floor's all-negative bias) -- so a symmetric band is principled and no penetration bias needs absorbing

pass_count_table.note: chosen -- obj_6 lamp only; sharp, no structural contamination

threshold_calibration.tempting_negatives_recorded: obj_63 picture (gap -0.0363, near but rejected by contact at 0.02), obj_84 pillar and obj_17 window (structural, rejected by contact) are included as real negatives so the threshold choice is auditable, not vibes-based.

synthetic_room_convention.description: Right-handed frame, gravity=(0,0,-1), up=(0,0,1). North wall at y=2 (interior-facing normal -y), floor at z=0 (interior/up normal +z). Plane a*x+b*y+c*z+d=0; (a,b,c) is the interior-facing normal. Synthetic entity centroids given explicitly (CONTACTS_SURFACE consumes the centroid).

clause_glossary.wall_gap: min over 8 AABB corners of signed_distance(corner, plane) (== sd_min)
clause_glossary.CONTACTS_SURFACE: wall_capable AND on_interior_side AND contact AND footprint_ok

cases.rationale: Real Replica wall-contact positive, grounded by measurement. Lamp against wall_33_yplus: footprint over the wall polygon, centroid on the interior side, wall_gap +0.0027 (within the symmetric +/-0.02 band). The only real CONTACTS_SURFACE positive under the frozen threshold. Boolean asserted; exact AABB comes from the live bundle.

Real near-but-rejected negative. The picture is the tempting 'attached to wall' object, but wall_gap -0.0363 is past the -0.02 penetration bound, so contact fails at the frozen 0.02/0.02 band. Makes the precision-over-recall choice auditable. (Attachment is deferred in P5 anyway -- D2.)

Real structural-contamination negative. A pillar (floor-to-ceiling architecture, 2.7 m) geometrically near a wall but rejected at 0.02/0.02 (wall_gap -0.0288 past -0.02). Documents that looser thresholds would wrongly admit architecture as 'against the wall'.

Real structural-contamination negative. A window is embedded in the wall (part of the architecture); rejected at 0.02/0.02 (wall_gap -0.0389). Another auditable exclusion of structure from the wall-contact answer.
Synthetic wall positive (exact geometry, no fit bias). Nearest corner 1 cm off the wall on the interior side; footprint within the wall polygon. CONTACTS_SURFACE.
Near but not touching: wall_gap 0.05 > contact_threshold 0.02. Single-clause contact rejection.
At contact depth but laterally outside the wall polygon (x beyond the wall edge): in_plane_gap 1.0. Single-clause footprint rejection.
Wrong side (exterior, y>2): centroid behind the wall fails on_interior_side and the deep negative gap fails contact. Multi-clause by construction.

Orientation-gate isolation: an entity resting on a FLOOR (up-facing surface) fed to the wall predicate. Contact/side/footprint all pass, but wall_capable fails (dot(normal,up)=1 > sin(30)). Single-clause wall_capable rejection -- proves the gate excludes horizontals (the mirror of ON_SURFACE excluding verticals).

cases.threshold_pinning: wall_gap -0.025 passes at penetration_tolerance 0.03 but is rejected at the frozen 0.02. Makes the symmetric-band choice auditable as a fixture assertion (mirrors the real picture/pillar negatives).
cases.rationale: Threshold-pinning penetration case: 2.5 cm into the wall, rejected by contact at the frozen symmetric 0.02 band.
